Error: incorrect POI attributes; Outdated: obsolete or expired data; Missing: missing POI information; Anomaly: abnormal user behavior signals; Relocation: POIs that have moved to new locations.
Table 2: Accuracy comparison on Extended BFCL. Whether strong closed-source models or specialized tool-use models, TA significantly boosts their performance.

Figure 1: Overview of the HTAA framework. The methodology comprises two core components: Toolset Agentization, which abstracts fine-grained tools into a hybrid toolset (combining basic and agent tools) to reduce planning complexity; and Asymmetric Planner Adaptation, which aligns the planner via a trajectory construction pipeline (backward reconstruction and forward refinement) followed by hybrid policy optimization, while keeping the agent tools frozen to ensure stable coordination.
